content.title: Trump's trade war could cost automakers around the world $30B
content.description:
President Trump's trade wars could cost global automakers up to $30 billion in combined profit, according to a report from Moody's Ratings.

Yahoo Finance senior autos reporter Pras Subramanian assesses this report's findings on how the Trump administration's tariffs will weigh on auto company's operating margins.

Also check out Yahoo Finance's full interviews with Ford (F) CEO Jim Farley and General Motors (GM) Buick and GMC global vice president Jaclyn McQuaid.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination.
